## Root Browser v5.0.0 — Initial Release

### 🎯 Core Features
- Tor auto-detection (works with or without Tor)
- Anti-fingerprinting engine (6 security levels)
- Ad blocker with subdomain matching
- Dark theme UI
- Multi-tab browsing (up to 15 tabs)

### 🔒 Privacy & Security
- Real SSL/TLS certificate validation
- WebRTC leak protection
- Canvas fingerprint randomization
- WebGL vendor spoofing
- AudioContext noise injection
- Screen size masking
- Timezone spoofing
- Encrypted password manager (Fernet)
- Session persistence (SQLite)

### 🛠️ Security Tools
- Hash Cracker (MD5, SHA1, SHA256, SHA512, NTLM)
- SQL Injection Scanner (GET/POST)
- HTTP Request Repeater
- DOM Manipulator
- Dark Web Search
- Certificate Viewer
- Cookie Editor
- JavaScript Console
- Python Console
- DevTools / Inspector

### 🎨 Browser Features
- Multiple search engines
- User-agent switcher (6 presets)
- Screenshot capture
- Save page as HTML
- Extract links & images
- View HTML comments
- Generate wordlist from page
- Toggle dark mode for any site
- Bookmark & history
- Notes pad
- Panic button

### ⚖️ Legal
- Comprehensive license & disclaimer
- Warning dialogs for dangerous tools
- IT Act 2000 compliance notice
- 18+ age requirement

### 📦 Installation
1. Install Python 3.8+
2. Run: `pip install PyQt5 PyQtWebEngine requests beautifulsoup4 stem cryptography pycryptodome`
3. Run: `python engine.py`

### 🚀 First Run
- Accept the license
- Tor will be auto-detected
- Start browsing!
